IAS Officer and Ex-Minister Taken Into Custody in Separate Scams

Suspended IAS officer Gyanendra Gangwar has been taken into ED custody in connection with the KPSC Recruitment Scam. In a separate case, former Andhra Pradesh Minister Karumuri has also been taken into custody by the ED in connection with a liquor scam.
